# Coolify template fixtures

`actualbudget.yaml`, `langfuse.yaml` and `appwrite-excerpt.yaml` are copied from
[coollabsio/coolify](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify) `templates/compose/`
at commit `424dbd36fff39a9ccd22efbee019cf490dcf9fc8`, Apache-2.0.
`appwrite-excerpt.yaml` is the first 60 lines of `appwrite.yaml`; the others are
verbatim. See `docs/attribution/coolify.md`.

The remaining fixtures are GuildServer's own, written to cover parser edge cases
that no upstream file exercises cleanly.
